title: faux fur blanket
text: faux fur blanket. Super soft, double sided (same on both sides). Machine washed and dried easily - no lint.  Has a bit of weight to it but is not super thick which is perfect for a cozy nap in my opinion.  Medium gray in color.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: GRACED SOFT LUXURIES Softest Warm Elegant Cozy Faux Fur Home Throw Blanket (Marbled Ivory, Large 50" x 60")
features: LARGE THROW BLANKET: 50"x 60", perfect as a couch throw, sofa throw and bed decorative throw - Large enough for adults to snuggle in.

ULTRA PLUSH SOFTNESS: These decorative faux fur throw blankets offer beautiful warmth and softness that is extremely warm and cozy.
100% GUARANTEED: This high quality soft & comfy faux fur throw blanket does not shed & has a 365 manufacturer warranty.
EASY MAINTENANCE: Keep your luxury faux fur throw blanket looking brand new by machine washing cold, hang or dry flat.
